headline: Paraguay President Resigns Amid Banking Crisis and Impeachment Trial
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena resigned and faced an impeachment trial following a financial crisis and banking takeover that blocked a large portion of the population from accessing their money.
why: Severe banking crises and political instability in emerging markets disrupt local credit flows, currency stability, and investor confidence.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A national banking crisis and presidential resignation destabilize local financial markets and institutional credit.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A systemic banking collapse locking customer funds combined with presidential resignation and an impending impeachment trial created acute sovereign and financial distress.
